plugins.name: bmad-batch-build
plugins.description: BMAD batch build: one bmad-build-auto worker per unit, in parallel worktrees or in turn in one worktree (chosen automatically), then a synthesis agent opens one Azure DevOps PR, or one PR per unit with bmad-batch-build-split.

plugins.name: ado-eod-report
plugins.description: Azure DevOps status reports for leadership: the end-of-day report and the weekly report (Monday to Sunday), summarised by user story with every story, task and PR and its status, upcoming work inferred from it, and blockers, copied as rich text that pastes into Teams with its formatting.
